messages:
Noemi (Onboarding Lead): Quick check  I sent the cohort orientation invite for Tue 12/07 18:00 UTC but heard from 3 new hires that times are off and one didn't see the Zoom passcode in their Outlook mobile preview. Any quick wins? cc @notion-bot and @IT Ops

notion-bot: Event created. Recording will be posted to Notion onboarding page /Onboarding/Orientation once available. ICS attached to original invite.

Ravi Singh: My colleague in APAC saw it as 02:00 local and their calendar had no passcode. Outlook mobile is weird about previews — it often hides non-plain-text lines.

Elena V.: Recreate in UTC and put the join URL and numeric passcode each on its own line in the description (no angle brackets). Also add a tiny "Local times" list for PST/CET/SGT/AEST and an "APAC note" telling people to DM for a local ICS if it falls overnight.

IT Ops: For Outlook desktop/mobile: ensure exported ICS has VTIMEZONE + TZID and DTSTART with TZID (not Z). Some clients treat a Z suffix as absolute UTC and then convert twice.

Noemi (Onboarding Lead): Cool. Is there a simple command someone recommends to produce an ICS with explicit timezone blocks so I don't have to hand-edit the file?

Ravi Singh: We use a tiny Python helper at scale, gist link pasted below in the Notion doc, but quick: gcalcli works if you set timezone and then export. Example: `gcalcli add --when "2026-12-07 18:00" --duration 75 --title "Redwood Orientation (Dec cohort)" --description "Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/xxxx\nPasscode: 778899\nLocal times: UTC 18:00 | PST 10:00 | CET 19:00 | SGT 02:00" --calendar "Onboarding"` then export ICS and verify VTIMEZONE present.

Elena V.: If you're worried about Outlook mobile stripping the passcode, duplicate the join info in the top-line summary and again in the first plain-text line of the description: e.g., `SUMMARY:Join: https://zoom.us/j/xxxx (pass 778899)` and first desc line `Join: https://zoom.us/j/xxxx Passcode: 778899`. Ugly but works across clients.

IT Ops: Alternative: publish the event (More actions -> Publish event) and paste the three "Add to calendar" links (Google/Outlook/Apple) in the Notion onboarding page. People can click the link for their client and it tends to avoid ICS parsing issues.

Noemi (Onboarding Lead): Plan: I'll recreate the invite in UTC, include join URL + passcode as plain-text lines, add the small local-times list and APAC note, attach an exported ICS that I verify for VTIMEZONE/TZID, and publish add-to-calendar links on Notion. I'll mark event Busy. After the session I'll embed the recording in Notion and also add a Box link for anyone who needs direct download.

Ravi Singh: One more gotcha we ran into: Exchange hosted tenants sometimes need EXDATEs for exceptions rather than editing single occurrencess in a series. If you do a one-off move, add EXDATE for the original DTSTART to avoid duplicate instances.

Elena V.: Also add this tiny troubleshooting blurb in the description: "If your calendar still shows the wrong time, check OS timezone and event timezone. DM Noemi with your OS + calendar client (e.g., macOS Calendar 14 / Outlook for iOS / Gmail mobile) and we'll hand-export an ICS for your zone."

notion-bot: Notion page updated: https://redwood.notion.site/Onboarding-Orientation-Dec-2026. Contains Add-to-calendar links, ICS downloads, and post-session recording slot.

Noemi (Onboarding Lead): Thanks all  I'll post the new invite link + ICS here when done. ETA: EOD PST. If anyone still sees strange behavior after that, please reply with the exact client + OS and I'll hand-export a zone-specific ICS.
